name: dw-resource-console
description: 数据仓库资源管理系统 - 批量调度服务器 / 调度平台IP / 采集交换平台IP / NAS / GDS 服务器 统一管理控制台

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @dw/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @dw/shared && npm run dev -w @dw/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dw/shared && npm run build -w @dw/api && npm run build -w @dw/web
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/smoke-project.mjs && node scripts/smoke-dict.mjs && node scripts/smoke-slot-capacity.mjs && node scripts/smoke-capacity-period.mjs && node scripts/smoke-hierarchy-period.mjs && node scripts/smoke-user.mjs
